message:
Run solver trials in parallel Web Workers with successive halving

Each worker loads its own copy of the unmodified game bundle on a small
fake-DOM shim (linkedom), so solver trials run off the page: the live game
keeps running and is never touched. Both solvers use a shared worker pool
and fall back to the page when workers cannot start.

- Glyph Solver screens every loadout quickly, then the best quarter, then
  the top 10 (successive halving); "Exhaustive" keeps the old search.
  On a real endgame save it finds the same top 10 as the exhaustive search.
- EC Solver evaluates each coordinate-descent round as one parallel batch.
- Trials are reseeded identically, so loadouts face the same luck and a
  worker trial matches the same trial on the page.
- Simulations skip page-only work (theme/perk graph rebuild, animations,
  automator scrolling) and take the Quick Glyphs path for huge amplified
  Realities.
- Adds Dual Machines and other endgame currencies as Glyph Solver metrics.
